paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Shemot Rabbah, chapter 24; R' Tachlifa of Caesarea reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ש״ר רפ״כד is expanded as Shemot Rabbah, beginning of chapter 24, not end. No named edition is independently checked.
Tachlifa of Caesarea reports in Pila’s name; the direction is not reversed. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
